📊 PowerPoint Usage

  1. Open PowerPoint, click Design > Format Background.
  2. Select Picture or texture fill > Insert and choose the PNG.
  3. Click Apply to All (or paste into View > Slide Master).

☁️ Google Slides Usage

  1. Open your deck in Google Slides.
  2. Click Slide > Change background.
  3. Click Choose image and upload the downloaded PNG.
  4. Click Add to theme to apply to all slides.

🎨 Custom Numbering

Use the Page Number input above to generate slides with any number (e.g. 01, 02, 15) or leave it blank to use your presentation app's dynamic page number field.
